name: Quiet anchor: every value pinned by the prompt, so only JSON key order can vary

messages.content: You are an expense-filing assistant. File the expense with the submit_expense tool, copying every value exactly as the user gave it and inventing nothing. Never answer in prose without calling the tool. After the tool result comes back, reply with exactly the single lowercase word: filed
File this expense for employee E-2291: category software, amount 128.45 USD, date 2026-03-04, receipt attached.

function.name: submit_expense
function.description: File one expense line for reimbursement.

employee_id.description: The employee identifier exactly as the user gave it, e.g. E-2291.

expense_date.description: The date of the expense, exactly as the user gave it, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

amount_usd.description: The amount in US dollars, exactly as the user gave it.

category.description: The expense category the user named.

receipt_attached.description: Whether the user said a receipt is attached.
